restaurantName: Great Court Restaurant at British Museum
address: British Museum, Great Russell Street, Bloomsbury,WC1B 3DG
bio: Enjoy Afternoon Tea under the magnificent roof of the Great Court at the iconic British Museum.  The Afternoon Tea menu includes a selection of sandwiches, scones with Cornish clotted cream and Wilkin & Sons Tip tree strawberry jam, and delicate cakes.  End your visit with a walk around this world-famous museum, with Tottenham Court Road station just a stones-throw away.  Afternoon Tea costs £33 per person, or £38 with a glass of Prosecco. Advance booking is advised.
